svg.text: 6-LAYER PCB CAD LAYOUT & STACKUP • LEXICON DUAL-RF USB DONGLE (60.40 × 28.40 × 1.60 mm)
• Base Material: High-Tg FR4 (Tg ≥ 170°C, Isola 370HR / Shengyi S1000-2M)
• Finished Dimensions: 60.40 mm × 28.40 mm (±0.10 mm CNC Routed Outline)
• Panelization for SMT: 2×5 Array (10-up) with 5mm Breakaway Rails & Fiducials
• Surface Finish: Immersion Gold (ENIG, 2µ" Au over 120µ" Electroless Ni)
• Via Plugging: 0.20mm RF & QFN-32 EPAD Vias Plugged (IPC-4761 VII)
• Min Trace / Space: 0.127 mm (5 mil) / 0.127 mm (5 mil)
• E-Test: 100% Flying Probe Netlist + TDR 50Ω ±5% Coupon
2. EXCELLON CNC DRILL & LAYER COLOR LEGEND
Tool Drill Ø Pad Ø Count Type / Function
T01 0.20 mm 0.40 mm 148 PTH RF Shield Fence & QFN-32 EPAD Thermal Vias
T02 0.30 mm 0.60 mm 32 PTH +5V / +3V3 Power Rail Interconnect Vias
T03 0.60 mm 1.00 mm 4 PTH Single USB-C Receptacle Shield Mounting Legs
T04 1.60 mm 3.20 mm 4 PTH M1.6 Grounded Enclosure Alignment Bosses
L1 (F.Cu): Top 50Ω CPWG Dual RF Feeds & USB Diff
ENIG Gold Guard Ring & 148-Via RF Fence
3. SMT PCBA ASSEMBLY & PARALLEL RF TEST PROTOCOL
• Solder Alloy: SAC305 Lead-Free RoHS (Peak 245°C Reflow)
• Inspection: 100% 3D SPI + 3D AOI + X-Ray on U2/U3 QFN-32
• QFN-32 EPAD Void Criteria: < 20% Total Area (IPC-A-610G)
• Automated Pogo-Pin ICT & Dual-Port RF Test (40 sec/board):
1. Flash Option-C v3 ESP-IDF Firmware via J1 USB-C
2. Verify SPI2 (U2 LR2021 #0) & SPI3 (U3 LR2021 #1) IDs
3. Measure S11 < -15 dB & S21 Isolation > 55 dB (J2 vs J3)
4. Verify Parallel Dual-Band TX (Sub-GHz + 2.4GHz) on J2 & J3
